title: Simple Portfolios that Deliver Consistent Decent Returns
abstract: arXiv:2610.36491v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Portfolio construction has been studied extensively in both academia and industry. Its applications range from pension funds and hedge funds to private savings. The academic literature centers on methodology, commonly evaluated in settings that allow short selling, leverage, and frequent trading. Industry, on the other hand, operates under real constraints, but its data and methods are proprietary and largely unpublished. Neither is directly available to the private investor. This paper is an empirical study of established portfolio construction methods in the setting of the private investor. We consider a small investable universe of liquid US ETFs, where trading is monthly and carries a cost, and neither shorting nor leverage is permitted. translated_title: 带来持续稳健收益的简单投资组合
translated_abstract: 投资组合构建在学术界和产业界都得到了广泛研究，其应用范围涵盖养老金、对冲基金乃至个人储蓄。学术文献以方法论为中心，通常在允许卖空、使用杠杆和频繁交易的设定下进行评估；而产业界则在现实约束下运作，但其数据和方法属于专有信息，大多未公开发表。这两者对个人投资者而言都无法直接获取。本文在个人投资者的设定下，对已有的投资组合构建方法进行了实证研究。我们考虑一个由流动性较好的美国ETF组成的小型可投资范围，其中交易按月进行且带有成本，同时不允许卖空或使用杠杆。我们将投资组合构建表述为一个凸优化问题，其输入由公开数据估计得出，且每个参数均可解释。我们将这样的投资组合称为“简单”投资组合。我们发现，简单……
tldr: 本文在个人投资者的现实约束下（仅投资少数流动性好的美国ETF、月度交易且有成本、不可卖空或加杠杆），通过凸优化和公开数据构建参数完全可解释的“简单”投资组合，实证表明其能带来持续且可观的收益。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically shows that under realistic retail-investor constraints (a small universe of liquid US ETFs, monthly trading with costs, no shorting or leverage), "simple" portfolios built via convex optimization with interpretable parameters estimated from public data can deliver consistent decent returns.
